description: Reading one Action from the JSON stored for a control, exactly as Swift's synthesized enum Codable does (DESIGN v2.4 B, v2.7 A). The value must be an object. Keys that are not case names are invisible; exactly one case key must remain, and its payload must be an object. sendPrompt needs a string "_0" in its payload; other payload keys are ignored. Anything else is not an action. expected is an action descriptor ({"case": <case name>} plus "prompt" for sendPrompt), or null when the value is not an action and the binding is dropped.
function: Action decoding — input any JSON value stored for one control, expected an action descriptor or null
verifiedBy: DESIGN.md v2.4 B and v2.7 A; Tests/PowerUpTests/MappingFixtureTests.swift testActionDecodeTable decodes an AppConfig from {"deviceMappings": {"p": {"c": input}}} (the production path) and reads the binding for p/c. Rust: rust/powerup-core/tests/mapping.rs action_decode_cases runs Action::from_wire on the input.

cases.name: an unknown sibling key is invisible
cases.reason: Swift's synthesized decoder only looks at keys that are case names, so an extra key written by a newer build is ignored and the binding survives.

cases.name: two case keys are rejected
cases.reason: An object naming two cases is ambiguous; the binding is dropped, never guessed.

cases.name: a number payload is rejected
cases.reason: The payload of a case must be an object.

cases.name: a null payload is rejected
cases.reason: The payload of a case must be an object.

cases.name: an array payload is rejected
cases.reason: The payload of a case must be an object.

cases.name: extra payload keys are ignored
cases.reason: Keys inside the payload that the case does not use are read past.

cases.name: sendPrompt without _0 is rejected
cases.reason: sendPrompt needs its prompt.

cases.name: sendPrompt with a number _0 is rejected
cases.reason: The prompt must be a string.

cases.name: sendPrompt with a null _0 is rejected
cases.reason: The prompt must be a string, not null.

cases.name: sendPrompt with a string payload is rejected
cases.reason: The payload is an object holding _0, never the bare prompt.

cases.name: sendPrompt ignores a second payload key
cases.reason: Only _0 is read; another key in the payload is ignored.

cases.name: sendPrompt keeps an escaped slash
cases.reason: \/ in the file is an ordinary slash once read.

cases.name: a bare string is rejected
cases.reason: An action is an object, never the case name as a string.

cases.name: an array is rejected
cases.reason: An action is an object.

cases.name: an empty object is rejected
cases.reason: An object with no case key names no action.

cases.name: null is rejected
cases.reason: A null binding is dropped, not read as none.

cases.name: case names are case-sensitive
cases.reason: Approve is not approve.

cases.name: an unknown case is rejected
cases.reason: An action this build does not know is dropped (the tolerant config load keeps the other bindings).
